name: nitpick
description: AI code review for AI agents: run nitpick before opening a PR and loop until the review is clean.

interface.shortDescription: Second-opinion code review before you open a PR.
interface.longDescription: Runs the nitpick CLI on your git diff: it sends the change plus the relevant repo context to a different model (OpenRouter or local) and returns structured findings. The skill installs nitpick, runs it, fixes what it finds, and reruns until the review is clean.
defaultPrompt: Run nitpick on my changes and fix what it finds.
Get a second-opinion review of this diff before I open the PR.
Install nitpick and set it up for this repo.
